subject: [AMBER] To know about the Forcefield of Pyrrolysine amino acid.

messages.author: PRIYANKA PUROHIT
messages.body:
Dear Sir,
I am Priyanka Purohit, a research scholar of  Berhampur University, Odisha,
India.I wanted to model one peptide sequence  that contain an unusual amino
acid '*Pyrrolysine'.  *Is it possible to model that peptide sequence using
currently available  AMBER force field. If no*, *then what should be used
here to model this one?
Thanking in advance,Waiting for your kind reply.
Regards,
Priyanka Purohit,
Research Scholar,
Berhampur university,
Odisha, India.
